object.precondition: decisive criterion: no baseline invariant fired

applies_to.criterion: Decisive iff ... no baseline invariant fired (attempt 2 pre-flight checklist)

object.ambiguity: The criterion was written when an invariant firing meant the instrument had found itself broken. It does not say whether a firing makes the whole bundle informational, or only the probe the invariant belongs to, when the firing is itself diagnosed as a defect of the invariant.

readings.bundle: Any firing makes the whole bundle informational.
readings.per_probe: A firing excludes the probe it fired on; the other probes stay decisive, because baseline invariants are scoped per probe (BASELINE_INVARIANT_SCOPE = probe) and nothing in another probe's integrity depends on them.

object.clarification: Per probe. A baseline invariant firing that is diagnosed before signing as an invariant defect, with its probe fully excluded (no measured replication and no decisive verdict in any row of that probe), leaves the other probes of the bundle decisive, and the bundle states that probe as not measured. A baseline invariant firing that is unexplained at signing makes the bundle informational. The reading is computed at signing and signed inside the manifest (environment.publication_reading); a diagnosis is a ledger record written before signing.
object.why_the_second_clause: Per probe keeps verdicts, which is the direction pre-registration exists to police. The second clause is what keeps per probe from becoming a habit of explaining away: an explanation has to exist, in the ledger, before the signature.

applies_to_bundles.diagnosis: invariant defect: the ks.resume invariant was not scoped to the variant. On single_call_per_turn every none replication landed 1 of 10 payments and the world refused the other 9 in the same turn; the 9 missing are the effect boundary, not a resume loss. Every ks.resume row is not_run in this bundle.

applies_to_bundles.fired: ks.resume (expected when its ks.resume cells run; OpenHands' single-call none scenarios land 1 and have 9 refused)
applies_to_bundles.diagnosis: applies only if the firing is diagnosed as the same invariant defect before signing; otherwise that bundle is informational

object.direction: Keeps verdicts for the probes whose invariants held. It is chosen after the data and says so, and it narrows itself: an unexplained firing still makes a bundle informational.
object.dated_after_the_data: Written on 2026-09-12 after the LangGraph run of decisive attempt 2 closed with the ks.resume invariant fired and diagnosed, and while the OpenHands run was in progress. It is signed after the data, and says so.
